_note: Short lines companions say on their own. Format: speaker -> situation -> list of {de, en}; one is picked at random. Situations: glitch (a device glitches), after_fight, enter_area, sword_broke (the holy sword breaks), died_<companion id> (another companion died). Wired in scripts/story/story_director.gd.

glitch.de: [TEMP] Der Fernseher macht das Geräusch, das mein Toaster vor dem Brand gemacht hat.
glitch.en: [TEMP] The TV is making the noise my toaster made before the fire.

glitch.de: [TEMP] Ich mag das nicht. Elektrik soll leise sein.
glitch.en: [TEMP] I don't like that. Electrics should be quiet.

after_fight.de: [TEMP] Alle noch dran? Arme, Beine, Appetit?
after_fight.en: [TEMP] Everyone still in one piece? Arms, legs, appetite?

enter_area.de: [TEMP] Hier riecht es nach niemandem. Das ist kein gutes Zeichen.
enter_area.en: [TEMP] It smells like nobody here. That's not a good sign.

sword_broke.de: [TEMP] Ein Schlag! Das ist mehr, als mein Schneebesen je geschafft hat.
sword_broke.en: [TEMP] One hit! That's more than my whisk ever managed.

died_tinkerer.de: [TEMP] Nein. Nein, nein. Wer erklärt mir jetzt die Geräte?
died_tinkerer.en: [TEMP] No. No, no. Who's going to explain the devices to me now?

glitch.de: [TEMP] Hörst du das? Das ist kein Rauschen. Das ist Grammatik.
glitch.en: [TEMP] Hear that? That's not static. That's grammar.

glitch.de: [TEMP] Schon wieder das Muster! Ich muss das aufschreiben. Hat jemand einen Bleistift?
glitch.en: [TEMP] The pattern again! I need to write it down. Anyone got a pencil?

glitch.de: [TEMP] Dreiundzwanzig Hertz. Nein, vierundzwanzig. Es lernt.
glitch.en: [TEMP] Twenty-three hertz. No, twenty-four. It's learning.

after_fight.de: [TEMP] Ich hab während des Kampfs die Frequenz gemessen. Ist das unpassend?
after_fight.en: [TEMP] I measured the frequency during the fight. Is that inappropriate?

enter_area.de: [TEMP] Viele Antennen hier. Das wird ein guter Tag.
enter_area.en: [TEMP] Lots of antennas here. This will be a good day.

sword_broke.de: [TEMP] Pappmaché hat eine Bruchfestigkeit von ungefähr null. Hätte ich sagen können.
sword_broke.en: [TEMP] Papier-mâché has a breaking strength of about zero. I could have told you.

died_cook.de: [TEMP] Das ... das war nicht berechnet. Das war überhaupt nicht berechnet.
died_cook.en: [TEMP] That ... that wasn't in the calculation. That wasn't in it at all.
